subject: Critical-path: POC environment closure & MAP final steps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Max Turner <max@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Critical-path: POC environment closure & MAP final steps

Hi Max / Lina —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, attaching the working Mutual Action Plan for the Helix Health POC (see attachment: redwood-map-draft-v3.pdf). Goal here is a concise checklist that maps out the last-mile items we need to complete the POC and move to a short pilot/paid trial: API keys, org setup, IP allowlist, and VPC peering.

High-level asks from your side this week:
- Approve the org admin list for Redwood access (we only need 1–2 admins).
- Confirm the maintenance window for VPC peering (preferred: Thu 8/26 00:00–04:00 PT).
- Provide the static egress IPs to populate the allowlist (or confirm you prefer wildcard / CIDR).

From our side we will:
- Pre-generate API keys scoped to the POC tenant and DM them to your admin once org access is accepted.
- Provision a test model endpoint in the us-west region and hand over smoke-test prompts.
- Share a VPC peering template and our network contact for the peering handshake.

I included Marissa (eng ops) and Neha (customer success) on this thread to coordinate the activation checklist and runbooks. If these asks look good, please reply with confirmation on org admins and the peering window. Once we have that, Marissa will drop the network activation plan and I’ll schedule the peering slot.

Thanks — looking forward to wrapping this up.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood-map-draft-v3.pdf (MAP draft — 3 pages)

From: Max Turner <max@helixhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lina Park <lina.park@helixhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2026 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Critical-path: POC environment closure & MAP final steps

Karthik —

Thanks for the doc and the clear next steps. Quick answers below:
- Org admins: Myself (max@helixhealth.com) and Lina (lina.park@helixhealth.com). We can accept via the invite.
- VPC peering window: Thu 8/26 01:00–03:00 PT works best for us. We can push the maintenance window earlier if your team prefers.
- IP allowlist: We will allow your listed egress CIDRs. Final static IPs will come from our infra team this afternoon — I’ll forward once I have them.

Couple of asks from our side: can you confirm whether the API keys will be scoped to read-only for logs or full ingest? Also want to confirm that data is not persisted outside the tenant during the POC (audit requirement).

If we get the peering window and keys confirmed, we can sign off on the MAP and move to activation.

—Max
Director, Platform Engineering
Helix Health

Thanks Max — great, that window works on our side too. I’ve attached the network activation checklist and the VPC peering template (network-activation-checklist.xlsx, vpc-peering-template.txt).

Operational checklist (actions assigned):
1) Org setup & invite (Karthik) — send tenant invite to Max + Lina; set admin role = Org Admin (limited to POC)
2) API keys (Neha) — create scoped keys:
   - key-poc-ingest (ingest + inference) — expires after 30 days unless extended
   - key-poc-logs (read-only) — used for pulling request logs; scope to HLX tenant
3) IP allowlist (Helix infra) — add Redwood egress CIDRs once provided; temporary allowlist entry for smoke tests will be added tonight 
4) VPC peering (Marissa + Jonas) — handshake, route table import, and acceptance during maintenance window (Thu 8/26 01:00–03:00 PT)
5) Smoke tests (Jonas) — post-peering: health check, token exchange, 10 sample inferences, latency benchmark
6) Rollback plan (Marissa) — revert peering and remove routes if any failures; preserve logs for audit

Security note: Neha, please confirm encryption-at-rest policy for the POC tenant and whether audit logging will be enabled (we typically enable full audit for enterprise POCs).

Max — I also pasted our minimal smoke-test checklist below for your infra team to prepare port access and routing rules. If you agree, I’ll schedule the peering and send the DocuSign link for the POC addendum after the API key scope is confirmed.

Attachment: network-activation-checklist.xlsx (rows: tasks, owner, ETA)
Attachment: vpc-peering-template.txt (BGP-less peering template)

—Marissa
Eng Ops Lead, Redwood Inference

Perfect — thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. Recap and firm next steps:

1) Org invite sent: Max and Lina should see the tenant invite in their inboxes now. Accepting the invite will allow Marissa to bind roles and for Neha to issue keys.
2) API keys: Neha will create keys scoped per checklist and DM the key-poc-ingest to Max via secure channel by EOD. These keys will be time-limited (30 days).
3) IP allowlist: Max to forward static egress IPs from Helix infra (we will add Redwood CIDRs to your allowlist tonight for smoke tests).
4) VPC peering: Scheduled for Thu 8/26 01:00–03:00 PT. Marissa and Jonas will execute the handshake; Jonas will post status to this thread when the peering is accepted.
5) DocuSign: I’ll send the POC addendum DocuSign link after API key scopes are finalized — expected before EOD.

If all goes as planned we’ll run smoke tests immediately after the peering acceptance (Jonas) and have a readiness decision by midday 8/27. If anything blocks, escalate to me and we’ll coordinate an emergency rollback.

Related resources: HubSpot deal HLX-2026-0921 (link above), internal MAP doc (link above).

Thanks again — small set of precise steps and we should be live for the Helix trial early next week.

Best,
Karthik
Sr. Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference

DocuSign: will send once keys confirmed
